roms.label: Rev H (2.H)
roms.note: The latest ROM for the Lisa Office System; also fine for MacWorks and Xenix. Boots the Office System here.

roms.label: Rev F (2.F), experimental
roms.note: An early Lisa 2 ROM. Loads and shows its startup menu, but starting a floppy through it does not work in this emulator yet.

roms.label: Rev 3A, experimental (MacWorks XL screen)
roms.note: For Lisas with the screen modification kit: a 608x431 screen, MacWorks only (it will not run the Office System). Untested without a MacWorks disk.
